MyVT-Gacha Code Review v4

Date: 2026-05-17
Reviewer: Azegami Rashiko (AI Agent)
Repo: eri-james/MyVT-Gacha
Live Demo: https://eri-james.github.io/MyVT-Gacha/
Files Reviewed (5,544 lines total):

File Lines Status
game.js 736 Reviewed
js/gacha.js 207 Reviewed
js/characters.js 140 Reviewed
js/data.js 41 Reviewed
js/minigame.js 527 NEW — Sprint 8
js/ui.js 1,386 Reviewed
index.html 345 Reviewed
css/style.css 2,162 Spot-checked

Executive Summary

This is the fourth code review round. Since v3, a significant new feature has been added — Sprint 8: Super Chat Toss minigame (minigame.js, 527 lines) — introducing a stamina system, a bubble-popping minigame with a boost meter / Super Chat mode, and lead character bonuses. The review also re-verifies all previously tracked issues.

Key Finding: Two previously-critical issues (CR-01 and CR-02) have regressed and are present again. A new critical issue has been found: the stamina system references four Game.* functions that do not exist in game.js, which would crash the game on startup. Additionally, three new high-severity issues were identified.

Severity New Regressed Still Open Fixed
Critical 1 2 0 0
High 3 1 2 2
Medium 3 0 1 1
Low 2 0 5 0
Total 9 3 8 3

New Issues (v4)

V4-01 — CRITICAL — Missing Stamina System Functions

File: game.js (functions not defined), called by ui.js:245-270 and minigame.js:72-78,388

Description: The new minigame and stamina UI call four functions on the Game module that are never defined in game.js and are not exported:

  • Game.getStamina() — called every tick via updateStaminaDisplay() (ui.js:246)
  • Game.useStamina(cost) — called in Minigame.startRound() (minigame.js:388)
  • Game.getStaminaTimeToNext() — called in updateStaminaDisplay() (ui.js:265)
  • Game.notifyStateChange() — called in Minigame.endRound() (minigame.js:476)

Since updateUI() is invoked during UI.init() and every 1-second tick, and updateStaminaDisplay() is called within updateUI(), the game will throw a TypeError: Game.getStamina is not a function and crash on startup.

Impact: Game cannot start. Entire application is broken.

Suggested Fix: Add a stamina system to game.js:

⎗
✓

// In createNewState():
stamina: { current: 200, max: 200, lastRegenTime: Date.now() },

// New functions:
function getStamina() {
  const s = state.stamina;
  if (!s) return { current: 200, max: 200, isFull: true };
  const elapsed = Date.now() - (s.lastRegenTime || Date.now());
  const regenRate = 300000; // 5 min per stamina
  const gained = Math.floor(elapsed / regenRate);
  if (gained > 0 && s.current < s.max) {
    s.current = Math.min(s.max, s.current + gained);
    s.lastRegenTime += gained * regenRate;
  }
  return { current: s.current, max: s.max, isFull: s.current >= s.max };
}

function useStamina(amount) {
  const s = state.stamina;
  if (!s || s.current < amount) return false;
  s.current -= amount;
  save();
  if (_onStateChange) _onStateChange();
  return true;
}

function getStaminaTimeToNext() {
  const s = state.stamina;
  if (!s || s.current >= s.max) return 0;
  const regenRate = 300000;
  return regenRate - (Date.now() - (s.lastRegenTime || Date.now())) % regenRate;
}

function notifyStateChange() {
  if (_onStateChange) _onStateChange();
}

Also add to migrateState(), createNewState(), exports, and startTickLoop() (call getStamina() each tick to trigger passive regen).

V4-02 — CRITICAL — Tick Loop Double-Divides Income (CR-01 Regression)

File: game.js:397-404

Description: The startTickLoop() function passes 1/60 (one second as fraction of a minute) to calculatePerMinuteIncome(), then divides the result by 60 again:

⎗
✓
1
2
const earnings = calculatePerMinuteIncome(1/60);  // already 1/60th of per-minute rate
state.currencies.stars += earnings.stars / 60;     // divided by 60 AGAIN

calculatePerMinuteIncome(minutes) returns perMinuteRate * minutes. With minutes = 1/60, it returns perMinuteRate / 60 (correct per-second rate). The extra / 60 makes real-time earnings 60x slower than they should be.

Meanwhile, claimOfflineEarnings() calls calculatePerMinuteIncome(minutes) directly with the actual elapsed minutes, so offline earnings are 60x faster than real-time. This creates a massive exploit: players earn far more by logging out and back in.

Impact: Real-time income is 60x slower than displayed rates. Offline income is 60x faster than real-time. This is the same bug identified as CR-01 in the original review.

Suggested Fix: Remove the extra / 60:

⎗
✓
1
2
3
4
5
6
const earnings = calculatePerMinuteIncome(1/60);
state.currencies.stars += earnings.stars;        // no extra division
state.currencies.starDust += earnings.starDust;
state.currencies.starFragments += earnings.starFragments;
state.currencies.bondPoints += earnings.bondPoints;
addStudioExp(earnings.studioExp);

V4-03 — CRITICAL — addStudioExp Infinite Loop on Multi-Level (CR-02 Regression)

File: game.js:287-298

Description: The addStudioExp() function captures nextLevel before the while loop and never re-assigns it inside:

⎗
✓

function addStudioExp(amount) {
    state.studio.exp += amount;
    const nextLevel = STUDIO_LEVELS.find(l => l.level === state.studio.level + 1);  // captured ONCE
    while (nextLevel && state.studio.exp >= nextLevel.exp) {
      state.studio.level = nextLevel.level;
      if (nextLevel.level >= STUDIO_LEVELS.length) break;
      const checkNext = STUDIO_LEVELS.find(l => l.level === state.studio.level + 1);
      if (checkNext && state.studio.exp >= checkNext.exp) {
        // empty body — does nothing
      } else {
        break;
      }
      // nextLevel is NEVER updated — still references the old level
      // state.studio.exp >= nextLevel.exp is still true → infinite loop
    }
}

If a large XP grant causes the studio to skip multiple levels (e.g., granting 1500 XP at level 1, which passes levels 2 and 3), the loop will freeze the browser because nextLevel still points to the first threshold already surpassed.

Impact: Browser tab freezes. Game becomes unresponsive. Players lose unsaved progress.

Suggested Fix: Compute nextLevel inside the loop:

⎗
✓
1
2
3
4
5
6
7
8
function addStudioExp(amount) {
    state.studio.exp += amount;
    while (true) {
      const nextLevel = STUDIO_LEVELS.find(l => l.level === state.studio.level + 1);
      if (!nextLevel || state.studio.exp < nextLevel.exp) break;
      state.studio.level = nextLevel.level;
    }
}

V4-04 — HIGH — Featured Banner Display Shows Wrong Characters

File: ui.js:469-485

Description: The featured banner display calls Gacha.generateFeatured() every time updateBannerInfo() is rendered, generating a fresh random set of 4 characters. However, the actual pull logic uses a different set that was generated once at init by setupFeaturedBanner().

⎗
✓

// init — sets actual featured for pulls
function setupFeaturedBanner() {
    const featured = Gacha.generateFeatured();  // random set A
    Gacha.setFeatured(featured);
}

// Every pull tab render — shows different characters
function updateBannerInfo() {
    ...
    const featured = Gacha.generateFeatured().slice(0, 4);  // random set B ≠ A
    descEl.textContent = `Rate up: ${featured}`;
}

The player sees "Rate up: X, Y, Z, W" but pulling on that banner actually rate-ups different characters.

Impact: Misleading UI. Players make pull decisions based on false rate-up information.

Suggested Fix: Store the featured characters at init and reuse them for display:

⎗
✓

let _featuredDisplay = [];
function setupFeaturedBanner() {
    _featuredDisplay = Gacha.generateFeatured();
    Gacha.setFeatured(_featuredDisplay);
}
function updateBannerInfo() {
    ...
    const names = _featuredDisplay.slice(0, 4).map(s => {
        const c = DataLoader.getBySlug(s);
        return c ? c.name : s;
    }).join(', ');
    descEl.textContent = `Rate up: ${names}`;
}

V4-05 — HIGH — Pull Animation Double Toast

File: ui.js:385-397

Description: When a pull animation is shown, both a click handler and an 8-second auto-close timer are registered. If the user clicks to close early, the auto-close timer is not cleared, causing the result toast to appear a second time after 8 seconds.

};
overlay.addEventListener('click', closeHandler);

const autoCloseTimer = setTimeout(() => {  // NOT cleared on early click
    overlay.style.display = 'none';
    overlay.removeEventListener('click', closeHandler);
    showPullResultToast(sorted.length, newCount, counts);
}, 8000);

Impact: Confusing UX — duplicate toast notifications after every pull.

Suggested Fix: Clear the timer in the click handler:

};

V4-06 — HIGH — data.js Missing Response Validation

File: data.js:9-21

Description: The load() function does not check resp.ok before parsing. A 404 or 500 response will either throw on .json() or produce invalid data:

⎗
✓
1
2
3
4
5
6
async function load() {
    if (_loaded) return _characters;
    try {
      const resp = await fetch('data/characters.json');
      _characters = await resp.json();  // no resp.ok check
      _loaded = true;

Also, the _loaded guard is set after the await, so concurrent calls during a pending fetch both proceed — a race condition.

Impact: Silent data corruption if the JSON file fails to load. Empty character array breaks all game features.

Suggested Fix:

⎗
✓

let _loading = false;
async function load() {
    if (_loaded) return _characters;
    if (_loading) {
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 100));
        return load();
    }
    _loading = true;
    try {
        const resp = await fetch('data/characters.json');
        if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${resp.status}`);
        _characters = await resp.json();
        _loaded = true;
        return _characters;
    } catch (err) {
        console.error('Failed to load characters:', err);
        return [];
    } finally {
        _loading = false;
    }
}

V4-07 — MEDIUM — Gem Rewards Not Persisted

File: minigame.js:444-476

Description: The minigame calculates totalGems (direct gem catches + score threshold bonuses) and shows them in the results screen, but never stores them anywhere in the game state. Only coinReward (as stars) and 10 bond points are saved:

⎗
✓
1
2
3
state.currencies.stars += coinReward;
state.currencies.bondPoints += 10;
// totalGems is displayed but never saved

Impact: Players see "+N Gems" in results but the gems vanish after closing the results screen. The currency appears to exist in the UI but has no backend.

Suggested Fix: Add a gems field to state.currencies and persist it:

⎗
✓
1
2
if (!state.currencies.gems) state.currencies.gems = 0;
state.currencies.gems += totalGems;

Also update the nav bar and UI to display the gem count.

V4-08 — MEDIUM — Auto-Backup Not Started

File: ui.js:13-27, game.js:416-419

Description: Game.startAutoBackup() is defined in game.js and exported, but never called in UI.init(). Auto-save (30s) is started, but auto-backup (5 min) is not. This means the 3-slot backup system defined in createBackup() never runs automatically.

Impact: No automatic backups are created. If localStorage is corrupted, players have no recovery.

Suggested Fix: Add to UI.init():

⎗
✓
1
Game.startAutoBackup();

V4-09 — MEDIUM — Dead Code in endRound()

File: minigame.js:460-463

Description: A no-op code block with a misleading comment:

⎗
✓
1
2
3
4
if (leadSlug && state.characters[leadSlug]) {
    const charData = state.characters[leadSlug];
    charData.level; // just access to confirm exists
}

Accessing a property without using its value does nothing. This appears to be a leftover from planned bond XP logic.

Impact: No functional impact. Code cleanliness issue.

Suggested Fix: Remove the dead code block or implement the intended bond XP logic.

Sprint 8 Observations

The new Super Chat Toss minigame (minigame.js) is well-structured overall:

Positives:

  • Clean game loop with requestAnimationFrame and delta-time capping
  • Proper cleanup on round end (cancelAnimationFrame, DOM removal)
  • Touch event support with { passive: false } for mobile
  • Difficulty scaling with phase-based spawn intervals and landmine weights
  • Combo counter and boost meter add engaging gameplay depth
  • DOM refs cached once via cacheDOM()

Areas for Improvement:

  • The missing stamina functions (V4-01) suggest Sprint 8 was deployed incompletely
  • Gem currency exists in the minigame but has no persistence (V4-07)
  • endRound() has dead code for bond XP (V4-09)
  • No daily play limit (minigame state has dailyPlays field but it's never checked)

Priority Fix Order

  1. V4-01 — Add stamina functions to game.js (game-breaking)
  2. V4-02 — Remove extra /60 in tick loop (game balance)
  3. V4-03 — Fix addStudioExp loop variable (freeze risk)
  4. V4-04 — Cache featured characters for display consistency
  5. V4-05 — Clear auto-close timer on early click
  6. V4-06 — Add resp.ok check and loading guard to DataLoader
  7. V4-07 — Persist gem rewards or remove gem display
  8. V4-08 — Call startAutoBackup() in init
  9. V4-09 — Remove dead code in endRound
  10. HP-03 — Sanitize innerHTML interpolation (use textContent or escape)
  11. HP-05 — Replace escape()/unescape() with TextEncoder/TextDecoder

Total issues tracked: 20 (3 Critical, 6 High, 5 Medium, 6 Low backlog)
